title: HydroAgent: Closing the Gap Between Frontier LLMs and Human Experts in Hydrologic Model Calibration via Simulator-Grounded RL

claim.summary: HydroAgent calibrates CREST/EF5 through tool-mediated simulator trials and trains a small LLM with supervised trajectories and simulation-feedback RL.

modules.name: Hydrologic parameter-simulation-evaluation episode
modules.scope_reason: Action parameters and NSE goals calibrate a hydrologic simulator, rather than directly forecasting a new time-series horizon.

modules.name: Hydrologic simulator-grounded LLM post-training
modules.scope_reason: Qwen3-4B is fully fine-tuned with SFT and GRPO over simulator feedback.
evidence_locators: PDF p.5; 2.4 Reinforcement Learning with Simulation Feedback
